description: Horaires des Bus de la Socièté de Transport du Sahel is a data set listed in Tunisian transport sector open data portal (data.transport.tn), a sector open data portal, published or maintained by Société de Transport du Sahel. Ce jeu de données décrit l'offre de transport (horaires, parcours, lignes, stations) pour le réseau bus de la STS. Coverage: Tunisia. The portal files it under the publisher Société de Transport du Sahel. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-01-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OTL (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tunisia-transport-open-data-portal.
